desc:
For real though, what's Yuiman been up to after the end of Fossilized Wonders? Did she really go back to Ariya 🤨 But why would she? Despite the shipping, it really seems more like Ariya couldn't give two shits about Yuiman.

It might be more likely that she just settles somewhere in the holy ground hunting deer. Maybe with Ubame showing her the ropes on how things work now these days and age.
